title.narrative: Strengthening Capacity for Freedom of Information and Data Activism in T¿rkiye's Civil Society

description.narrative:
Overall objective(s) (i.e. Impact): To contribute to increased access to public information and thus promote democracy in Türkiye through legal reform, collaboration across the civil society spectrum and capacity building.

Specific objective(s) 1) Develop an effective tracking and monitoring Freedom of Information requests system; 2) Strengthen monitoring and documenting of media freedom violations; 3) Improved capacity for advocacy and awareness raising, namely through the creation of a nationwide CSOs coalition; 4) Develop a legal defense fund to provide financial resources for CSOs and independent media to file cases to highlight that information has been withheld that should have been publicly disclosed; 5) Strengthen the capacity of CSOs and independent media on data activism.
